svg.title: Agentic SDLC end-to-end delivery architecture
svg.desc: Three lanes show how a product brief becomes a scoped task, source change, reviewed pull request, and authorized release. The staged runtime and Hetzner operations pilot provide target-environment evidence. Amber dashed boundaries denote adoption profiles that still require field validation.

svg.text: Customer application reference and production adoption profiles
Failures or stale evidence return to the worker
Ledger tested · Live GitHub App integration pending
Checks the same candidate and test cases
Verify main tree and rerun CI
Trusted observations: running digest, smoke, session behavior and recovery
Serial delivery → recovery drills → 24 h soak
Off-host restore · compare one and two workers
Evidence binds the approved run window
Source of record: GitHub Issues and PRs · Protected CI and target observations feed candidate-bound evidence gates
